$comment: Owned by @golemui/gui-schemas (libs/gui/schemas/src/lib/). Handwritten, edit directly. Shared date and time range definitions used by the gui component schemas.
title: GolemUI Range Definitions

dateRange.description: A single date range. The multiRange date widgets hold a list of them, and calendar and date-picker widgets use them to mark days as disabled.

start.description: ISO-8601 date string for the start of the range (inclusive)

end.description: ISO-8601 date string for the end of the range (inclusive). Omit to cover a single day.

completeDateRange.description: A date range with both ends set: the value of the single range date widgets (rangeCalendar, rangeDateInput, rangeDatePicker). A one-day range has the same start and end.

start.description: ISO-8601 date string for the start of the range (inclusive)

end.description: ISO-8601 date string for the end of the range (inclusive)

dateTimeRange.description: A single date-time range (two ISO date-times). The multiRange date-time widgets hold a list of them, and use them for disabled instant spans.

start.description: ISO-8601 date-time string for the start of the range (inclusive)

end.description: ISO-8601 date-time string for the end of the range (inclusive). Omit to cover the single instant at start.

completeDateTimeRange.description: A date-time range with both ends set (two local ISO date-times): the value of the single range date-time widgets (rangeDateTimeCalendar, rangeDateTimeInput, rangeDateTimePicker).

start.description: ISO-8601 date-time string for the start of the range (inclusive)

end.description: ISO-8601 date-time string for the end of the range (inclusive)

isoTime.description: A time of day as HH:MM or HH:MM:SS on a 24-hour clock

timeRange.description: A single time-of-day range. The multiRange time widgets hold a list of them, and time-picker widgets use them to mark times as disabled.

scopedTimeRange.description: A time-of-day range that optionally applies only on one date or on given weekdays. Used by date-time widgets to mark times as disabled.

date.description: ISO date: the range only applies on that date
